start: Member linked to Crispy Curves, trainer sent a plan, Workout tab opened

user_sees: A new folder with the plan's name
must_not: The folder followed by itself
The member's own folders changed

steps.action: Open the folder and start a routine
must_not: An empty routine shown
Exercises of another plan mixed in

start: Gym posts a workout of the day as well as plans

user_sees: A separate folder 'Workouts of the day'
must_not: The workout of the day merged into a plan folder
The plans sync relabelling 'Workouts of the day' as no longer sent

start: Member deleted a folder the gym sent

steps.action: Delete the gym folder, reopen the Workout tab after 10 minutes
must_not: The deleted folder comes back on the next sync

steps.action: Gym has no plan for the member
must_not: An empty folder or an error on the Workout tab

start: Gym folder on the phone; the trainer changes, then withdraws the plan

steps.action: Trainer saves a new version; open the Workout tab
user_sees: The folder updated; rows the member changed keep the member's version
must_not: The member's own edits overwritten
A second copy of the folder

steps.action: Trainer withdraws the plan; open the Workout tab
user_sees: The folder stays, labelled 'No longer sent by <gym>'
must_not: The folder or its past workouts deleted

user_sees: Every folder from that gym labelled as no longer sent
must_not: A late sync removing the label again

start: Member of Crispy Curves with gym plan folders

steps.action: Look at the folder and leave the gym
user_sees: Only plans the gym assigned to this member
must_not: Another member's plan arriving on this phone
The gym seeing the member's own folders

start: Workout tab opens, member linked, plan feature on, last ask over 10 minutes ago

steps.action: The app asks member_gym_plans with the member key
user_sees: New plan saved as a folder, remembered in the known list
Video links of the plans saved
must_not: A plan with no exercises saved as a folder
The folder followed

start: Member pulls to refresh within 10 minutes of the last ask

must_not: Two syncs running side by side saving the same plan twice

start: Phone offline, or the server says see the desk, or no plan feature

steps.action: The ask fails or answers not ok
must_not: Folders relabelled as gone because the answer was empty by error
An error shown on the Workout tab

start: Member switches from one gym to another

steps.action: Sync with the new gym's link
user_sees: Old gym's folders labelled no longer sent; new gym's plans added
must_not: The old gym's folders updated by the new gym
Old gym's folders deleted

steps.action: retireGymFolders runs after leaving while a sync is running
user_sees: The label stays after both finish
must_not: The running sync saving over the label
